instruction: Launch the video file from the desktop using VLC and begin playing it.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to open the music video file from desktop and start playback in VLC. Evaluator uses is_vlc_playing metric to check VLC's status.xml from HTTP interface, confirming both 'playing' state and correct filename match.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly fetches VLC status.xml from HTTP interface and saves it for metric analysis
Metric logic correctly verifies both playing state and filename match with multiple fallback strategies for finding filename in XML
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both requirements (VLC is playing AND correct file is playing)
Expected filename value matches the downloaded file from config
Runtime feasible: VLC HTTP interface is accessible while VLC is running, no postconfig needed
Metric correctly handles rule parameter (receives rules dict directly, not wrapped)
Robust filename matching with multiple strategies (exact basename, endswith, path-based)
